companion_files.records: records.json (all 197 definition records, parsed by recs.py, with English names)
companion_files.themes: rides_themes.json (FOLIO ids per theme/set for rides, features, shops, sideshows)
companion_files.english_text_table: ext/rip/0407.bin (FOLIO 0x197): u32 count=1031, then u32 offsets

type_enum.source: CONTEXT_ strings 0x800DDDD4.., pointer table 0x800F1090; record+0 and A+0x6A hold the same value

base_vtables.pool_entry_layout: outer+0 link(8 bytes), A = outer+8, vptr at A+0xC; subclass overrides carry delta -8

theme_tables.lookup: 0x8006A3CC(mgr,type,variant) -> FOLIO id; 0x8006A158(mgr,type) -> count; mgr = 0x80069610(), mgr+8 = theme, mgr+4 = set (0/1)

record_format.0x24 + 0x34*L: level block L=0..2 (code allows L=3 which reads past the record)

feature.0x2E: flag byte: bit0 usable by guests (slot 54)

attraction_fields.0xF8: int day stamp of last non-empty queue

status.tick: base Update 0x80065BE0: call slot 69+n (table 0x800E1370); queued-ride Update 0x8009CCD4 adds lifetime/closing logic; Ride Update 0x800A0084 adds 0x8009D0FC

values.1: under construction (tick 0x800659C4 -> 10 when the build phase completes)

status.upgrade: 0x8009C56C: level<3 -> level++, 0x8009C410 resets sliders+reliability, TrySpend(record[level].price*10); triggered by mechanic state 54 from the upgrade queue 0x801099EC (count 0x80102D48, push 0x8005BE14 from UI 0x8003BE00)

queue.join_rule: 0x8008DA14: status in {2,10,11} and (in-queue flag or members < 4*level+7)

partial_start.rule: queue empty for >= 5 game days (495 ticks) and riders > 0 -> SetStatus(2)

run.rule: each animation phase completed: A+0xF2 += 1; A+0xF2 >= A+0xC0 -> SetStatus(11)
run.phase_ticks: duration_u16 * 4096 / timescale (timescale ~9930/tick) ; duration from the model animation resource, not extracted

intensity.note: no stored excitement/appeal/queue rating exists; ride slots 54/55/56 return 0 for rides

wear.rate_fn: slot 104; Ride 0x800A0250 (a1=0 -> uses riders on board)
wear.rate: k = ((s + L)/2) * wearMult ; s = speed/100 (if speed>=100: (s+1)/2) ; L = riders/maxSeats (+((L-0.8)*64)^2/4096 if L>=0.8)

breakdown.reliability_threshold: A+0xB4 <= 0x9FFF (<10.0) while status 2 -> Ride: smoke + status 4 (0x8009D0FC); track 0x800A66EC / coaster 0x800B0A68 -> status 5
breakdown.status4_to_5: only if A+0xB4 == 0 exactly (practically unreachable for rides)
breakdown.lifetime_zero: A+0x68 == 0: message 0x99 (condemned), queued-ride Update closes the ride and sets 4; mechanics never claim it (0x80096C58 requires A+0x68 != 0); only placement/save-load reset A+0x68

messages.0x3E: Your ride is about to break down!
messages.0x3F: A ride has broken down, and you don't have any mechanics to fix it!
messages.0x40: A ride has broken down and all your mechanics are busy.
messages.0x41: A ride has broken down, and a mechanic is on his way to fix it.
messages.0x99: One of your rides has become too old and has been condemned.

mechanic.closing: state 16: A+0xEC += timescale/tick until 10*(w+h)<<12 (~33 ticks for 4x4)
mechanic.opening: state 17: A+0xEC -= timescale/tick to 0, then SetStatus(7) -> reliability 100 -> status 10
